blurb: This check reads the AIX error-notification database and reports what happens when the system logs a hardware or disk error. It distinguishes alerts that page or email an on-call responder from errors that only reach the built-in call-home path or that go nowhere. If no alert method is configured, a failing disk or other critical error is logged but never reaches a person, so a serious problem can go unnoticed until it causes an outage.
